name: St Botolph's, Barwick
tagline: The parish church of Barwick, keeping the daily office since 1348
_liturgical_note: This is the wedge. liturgy.js resolves the season before first paint and writes <html data-season>, liturgy.css maps it to --accent, and families/parish.css paints the hero panel in it. Set adventUse to 'sarum' for Sarum blue, lentUse to 'array' for the unbleached Lenten array — both are legitimate English use and the parish chooses, not us.

services.label: Holy Communion
services.note: Book of Common Prayer, said, no music

services.label: Parish Eucharist
services.note: Sung, with the choir and Sunday school

services.label: Choral Evensong
services.note: Book of Common Prayer, sung by the choir

services.label: Midweek Eucharist
services.note: In the Lady Chapel, followed by coffee

services.label: Evening Prayer
services.note: Said. Anyone may come; most weeks it is three of us

events.name: Advent Carol Service
events.description: The church in darkness, lit by candles carried in procession. Sung by the parish choir. No ticket and no collection.

events.name: Nine Lessons and Carols
events.description: The whole town's carol service, followed by mulled wine in the church hall.

events.name: The Easter Vigil
events.description: The new fire kindled in the churchyard, the paschal candle carried in, and the first Eucharist of Easter.
